title: Headline Analyzer
description: Score any headline on length, word balance and emotional pull — using built-in power-word and emotion-word banks.
howto: Type your headline or blog title.
Get an instant score from length, word count and word-type balance.
Swap in power words and emotional words suggested from the built-in banks to raise the score.

faqs.a: Length (ideal 55–70 chars / 6–9 words), presence of power words, emotional words, uncommon words and numbers each add points, for a 0–100 score graded A–F.
High-impact words like "proven", "secret", "ultimate", "free", "guaranteed" — the tool checks against a built-in bank of 60+ of them.

faqs.q: Is a high score a guarantee of clicks?
faqs.a: No — it measures headline craft, not audience fit. A "B" headline your readers care about beats an "A" they ignore.
